messages:
laura: Quick sync — need final numbers for GPU orders + region expansion for FY26 Q3/Q4. Leadership wants a procurement ask by EOD Friday. TL;DR: inference QPS growth ~18% month-over-month, fleet utilization trending toward 78% and coming up on our safety threshold. Please read then +1 or propose changes.

chris: can you paste the latest dashboard snapshot? i ran the new batching patches on the canary yesterday and have perf numbers.

laura: dashboard summary (high level):
```
- total_gpus: 420  (A100:200, H100:120, L4:100)
- avg_utilization (30d): 78%
- 95p latency SLO breach (30d): 0.9%
- monthly inference token growth: +18%
- projected token growth next 6mo: +60% if current trend continues
```
We are forecasting <12 months of safe headroom unless we add capacity or enable more aggressive quantization and batching.

sanjay: My read: order target should be +160 GPUs to keep steady-state utilization ~60-65% with expected growth. Proposed mix: 60% H100, 25% A100, 15% L4 (for embeddings/cheap workloads). Region preference: us-west-2 (primary), europe-west1 (secondary). Lead time: 12-16 weeks for procurement + install.

marta: Two notes from customers/finance: 1) Enterprise deals expect Private deployments in APAC — they want dedicated on-prem racks (40 GPUs) in ap-southeast. 2) Finance wants capex vs opex breakdown and a 3-year TCO. I'll sync with sales to get a list of queued customers that trigger APAC commitments.

chris: Alternative to heavy upfront procurement: hybrid approach — order +80 H100 now for core capacity, and rely on cloud burst (spot + reserved) for APAC and opportunistic demand for next 6 months. Rough cost sketch: 
```
- buy 80 H100 (capex) -> reduces headroom shortfall to ~30 GPUs
- cloud-bursting (6mo window) -> estimated extra capacity cost ~ $220k/mo
- total blended monthly cost ~ comparable to buying but defers larger capex
```
This buys us time to validate batching/quantization improvements.

laura: Good. Need 4 concrete deliverables before Friday 17:00 PT:
1) final GPU qty & mix (owner: sanjay)
2) region allocation by SKU (owner: sanjay + chris)
3) capex vs opex brief + 3yr TCO (owner: marta)
4) fallback plan (cloud-burst + spot autoscaling config + cost guardrails) (owner: chris)
Please post numbers here; I'll collate into the leadership ask doc.

sanjay: I'll post recommended PO numbers by tomorrow noon. Realistically: order 96 H100, 40 A100, 24 L4 (total 160). Region split: us-west-2: 80 H100 + 20 A100 + 12 L4; eu-west1: 16 H100 + 20 A100 + 6 L4; ap-southeast (private pockets): reserve 40 L4 for on-prem requests.

marta: I'll produce the TCO and attach rough P&L slide. Also raising the contract ask for APAC customers to cover a 6–12 month runway for private installs.

chris: I'll draft the cloud-burst config and simulated cost runs. Quick ask: does the procurement team need SKU-level vendor quotes now? If so i'll kick off vendor outreach.

laura: yes — vendor quotes would be helpful but not blocking the internal ask. We can include an LOE estimate.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Procurement sync scheduled Thu 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).

laura: thanks all — please keep updates in this thread. If anything changes (customer commit, shipping delays), call it out immediately. :thumbsup:
